name: The natural and magic set of clubs

body.h: The natural set of clubs is a set of nine clubs for colour coding many three person patterns. The set contains three clubs of each of three different colours. In our examples there will be three red clubs, three blue clubs and three green clubs.

The magic set of clubs is another set of nine clubs for colour coding many three person patterns. Take the natural set of clubs and replace one club of each colour with a white club. In our examples there will be three white clubs, two red clubs, two blue clubs and two green clubs.
